entry.title: Scatterloom 1.0.0
entry.summary: Scatterloom is a granular rhythm effect for MPC standalone. It captures grains from incoming audio and combines Euclidean rhythms with Markov-based grain selection. - MPC OS 3.10.1 or later; external plugin support must be enabled. - Gen 1 and Gen 2 packages are included. The Gen 2 build has not yet been tested on hardware. - Recent Grains defaults to nine in a new project. - Gen 1 benchmark on an MPC X: 14.8% and 14.4% worst-stage 99th percentile in two idle-project runs (OpenMPC PASS).
